quotes.author: Theodore Reinhard
quotes.text: 10/10 recommend! I took the four hour rental with a group of 17 people and we had a blast! We had Hannah as our Captain and she was awesome! She took us to a spot called Devils Cove where all the boats tie up with each other and have a big party. Bring some drinks, snacks and good music and you will have a great time!

quotes.author: Hannah Coco
quotes.text: Captain Jared was amazing! We had a great time and experience on the party barge. It was a fabulous day on Lake Travis. He was a very experienced driver and he fit in perfectly with our group. Everyone had so much fun. Renting with Centex boat rentals was the best decision we made! Will definitely come back again!

quotes.author: Alex Price
quotes.text: 5 star service. 5 star vibes. Bring your $ here on lake Travis! Captain Blake took exceptional care of my group for my 30th birthday on the black Malibu! Everyone got to surf relax celebrate and enjoy beautiful day on the lake…we did not want to leave or get off the boat! 😅

quotes.author: Haden Janak
quotes.text: We had a blast! Hannah was an outstanding captain, knowledgeable, safe, and took care of absolutely everything. We simply got to relax and enjoy our time out on beautiful Lake Travis. Centex has a great team and Hannah exemplified that, 10/10 would book with them again!
